Introduction to generative design: start, rule, repeat; noise and thresholds; cellular automata; agents and stigmergy; reaction-diffusion; growth; physics solvers; reading a result; design space and selection. Project 4 is reissued as three sheets presented at the final. Pick a generative strategy and a brand for a store of 40 to 64 m2 before next class.
